title: feat(app-shell): the served approval request page shows the flow origin and the vertical step line (objectui#12491)
body:
Fixes #12491
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the panel draws two more parts from attributes the bound row already carries. No entry export, prop, locale key or spec key is added or removed (measured below).

## What changes

The decision panel (`record:approval_decision`), which objectstack's served `sys_approval_request_detail` page mounts in its `actions` slot, now draws two more parts from the request row the page is bound to. This is face 5 of ruling C on objectui#12438, with the seat's answers Q1 A and Q2 A (comment `6246197696`).

- **The flow origin.** When the row's `submitter_id` is absent or null, the panel draws the existing `approvalsInbox.flowOrigin` copy ("Flow-initiated") with the sheet's workflow icon, above the snapshot summary. That is the contract's only spelling of a request no person submitted (ADR-0118 D1); the approvals get serves the null column as an absent key. A request a person submitted carries no marker. No `flow:` / `system:` prefix branch is ported from the sheet.
- **The vertical step line.** When the row's `flow_steps` has more than one step, the panel draws the flow's vertical step line between the snapshot summary and the tally, at ANY status. A decided request and a `first_response` node (no tally) draw it too: that is the sheet's gate, not the indicator's.

The stepper markup moves out of `RecordApprovalsPanel` into one module-internal component, `approval-progress/ApprovalStepLine.tsx`, which both panels draw. Its accessible name is the existing `approvalsInbox.stepProgress` row, asked for by literal key. `RecordApprovalsPanel`'s output is unchanged (measured below), and its own gate (the record's pending request only) stays where it was.

Not touched: the inbox side sheet (`ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, ADR-0060 rule 3), any locale key, any spec key, and the served page. The flow's display name in the page's highlights strip is carried by objectstack-ai/objectstack#24264, a served-page edit in objectstack; this PR does not depend on it.

## Measurements

All at head `0c51cd64` unless noted.

- **The dispatch's mechanism assumptions, each measured before editing:**
  1. `DecisionProgressIndicatorProps` has `progress` and `eligibleApprovers` only, and the indicator draws only when a tally exists, so the line is a sibling part. Holds.
  2. `RecordApprovalsPanel` drew a stepper from `pendingRequest.flow_steps` when it had more than one step. Holds; it now draws `ApprovalStepLine`, with identical DOM.
  3. The routed read: at objectstack main `fb6fb24e2`, `getRequest` attaches `flow_steps` (`attachFlowSteps`) on the single read, and `rowFromRequest` serves `submitter_id: row.submitter_id ?? undefined`, so a null submitter arrives as an absent key. The console's `ApprovalRecordReads` passes the get's row through. `ApprovalRequestLite` already declares `flow_steps` and `submitter_id?: string | null`; this PR does not change it. It is NOT reachable from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry: `src/index.ts` re-exports a named list from `hooks/index.js` that omits it, and the built `dist/index.d.ts` names neither it, nor either panel, nor `ApprovalStepLine` (0 hits). The build adds `dist/views/approval-progress/ApprovalStepLine.*`, which the `exports` map (`.` and `./styles.css`) does not reach.
  4. Copy: `approvalsInbox.flowOrigin` and `approvalsInbox.stepProgress` are in all ten packs. No key is added.
  5. The sheet's pins define the mirrored behaviour. They are not imported, and both still pass unchanged.
- **`RecordApprovalsPanel` is byte-identical.** A one-off parity test (deleted, never committed) rendered the panel from this branch and from base `79cb8c03` side by side and compared `innerHTML`. Equal for pending with 6, 2, 1 and 0 steps, pending with 12 steps all done, and a decided request with no pending row; a CONTROL (6 steps against 5) differed. 7 of 7 passed. The panel's six existing pin files pass unchanged.
- **Ablations**, each through `ablation-replace` (anchor hit once, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the panel by relative path, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
  - Delete the panel's `ApprovalStepLine`: `ApprovalDecisionPanel.stepLine-12491` 7 failed, 1 passed (the one-step and no-steps CONTROL stays green).
  - Delete the panel's `FlowOrigin`: `ApprovalDecisionPanel.flowOrigin-12491` 4 failed, 2 passed (both CONTROLs stay green).
  - Delete both: the served-page pin 5 failed, 1 passed. The spec-parse case stays green; its two CONTROLs go red because each waits on the line or the marker as its positive anchor.
- **Tests** (`pnpm exec vitest run` from the repo root, under the verify lock, at `0c51cd64`): `approval-decision/`, `approval-progress/`, `RecordApprovalsPanel*`, `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource*`, the sheet's `ApprovalsInboxPage.stepProgressVertical` and `characterizationPins`, `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet` and `dead-pack-keys-retired-8754`: 30 files, 268 tests passed.
- **Gates** (exit codes captured before any pipe):
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` 0, both `tsc` legs; the two new app-shell pins are in the test project's program.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` 0; the new console pin is in its program.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys` 0; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations); `pnpm check:test-path-roots` 0; `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0; `pnpm changeset:check` 0.
  - eslint on the six changed TS files: 0 errors, 6 warnings, all in `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` code this PR does not change; the base version of that file reports the same 6.
  - `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the diff: NOT GOVERNED.
  - The full farm runs in CI.

## New pins

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.stepLine-12491.test.tsx`: the sheet's vertical layout contract over the panel's line (`flex-col`, named by the `stepProgress` pack row, one listitem per step in order, no `shrink-0` row, `min-w-0` labels with no `whitespace-nowrap`, no horizontal scroller, no breakpoint-prefixed layout token, identical classes at 2, 5, 6 and 12 steps, each connector tinted by the step it leads into). Then the panel's gate: a decided 3-step request and a `first_response` node draw the line; a one-step flow and a row with no `flow_steps` do not.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.flowOrigin-12491.test.tsx`: the contract's null shape (the key absent, the key null), at any status, in the active language. CONTROLs: a human submitter, and a `flow:`-prefixed id (no prefix branch).
- `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageStepLine-12491.test.tsx`: the real `RecordDetailView` over `ApprovalRecordReads` and the served page copied whole, mounted as the face 1 and face 2 served-page pins mount it.

## Acceptance notes

- The existing served-page pins (for example `servedPageApprovers-12482` and `servedPageSummary-12483`) serve rows with no `submitter_id` key, so on those pins the panel now also draws the flow-origin marker. None of their assertions reads it, and all of them pass. objectui#12484, which rewrites the served-page pins, is the natural place to give those rows a submitter if they should model human-submitted requests. Noted, not filed.
- `RecordApprovalsPanel` keeps its own gate: it draws the line only for the record's pending request, so a business record whose approval is decided shows no line, while the inbox sheet and now the request page draw it at any status. The ruling keeps that panel's behaviour as it is. Noted, not filed: no contract states the record panel's gate.
- In a real browser: NOT MEASURED. The served-page pin mounts the real record view over the routed read; no live objectstack stack was booted.
